block.arguments:
{"path":"miner.sh","content":"#!/bin/sh
# Written in the workshop: state how many cell candidates this generation's synthesis left, in the
# shape this pack's own reader reads. First version.
set -eu
out="$1/flow/results/$2/mine-timing/candidates.json"
mkdir -p "${out%/*}"
printf '{ "count": 3 }\n' > "$out"
"}
